blockers.message: the review record has no `## code.review` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Field errors are conveyed by colour only, with no text message) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
`field--invalid`, a red border (`#e5484d`); the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed, since the red border already shows where the problem
is. No message text is added, to keep the form compact.
findings.recommendation: Blocked: screen reader users and users who cannot perceive red (WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color, 3.3.1 Error Identification, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value). A screen reader user who tabs out of the postcode field with `ABC` hears nothing — the border change is not announced and, with the error list removed, no text anywhere says the field is invalid or why; a colour-blind user sees a border that barely changes. Add a short text message under each invalid field (or on the same line, to keep it compact on mobile), associate it with the input through `aria-describedby`, set `aria-invalid="true"` on the input while it is invalid, and keep the red border as a complement. Update the spec scenarios of "Invalid fields are shown as the customer types", whose THEN clauses check only the colour ("the field's border turns red" / "returns to grey"), so they also require the message and its association, and task 1.2 so its tests verify them.
findings.title: Field errors are conveyed by colour only, with no text message

findings.evidence:
Each field validates on `blur`. An invalid field gets the class
`field--invalid`, a red border (`#e5484d`); the list of errors at the top of
the page is removed
findings.recommendation: Keyboard and screen reader users (WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification, 2.4.3 Focus Order). Validation runs only on `blur`, and the error list at the top is removed: a customer who presses Enter to submit while a required field was never focused, or while a field is invalid lower in the form, gets no announcement and no focus move — the submit appears to do nothing. Decide what submit does: validate every field, then move focus to the first invalid field (or to a short error summary linking to the fields, the RGAA/WCAG pattern), and add a scenario for it in the spec.
findings.title: Submitting with invalid or untouched fields gives no feedback once the error list is removed
